brief: Two checks of a cut source read during a re-encode fail on main: the waiting request got a 24-byte non-segment answer in under 200 ms instead of a segment from a fresh job (2 of 3 on main; 3 of 3 passed on the JS-168 tree), and the persisting-cause case got no failure (queue run 45086436037, and #225's run on 2026-11-20). Viewer effect reasoned, unverified. Options: a task now, before or beside JS-161, or backlog. (brief-triage-0522.md)
tradeoff: Nothing a viewer has is given up. JS-169's and JS-164's starts wait behind it; docs/status.md says less than it did about JS-088 until JS-159 merges.
serves: PRODUCT.md goal 1; 'Failures are invisible'; 'every failure is reported with its reason, never silent'; DOMAINS.md invariant 40.
entry: JS-159 moves from 25 to 16 and builds beside JS-161. The persisting-cause sighting is its own. It gains three criteria: both cut-read cases run 20 times on main under CI's shape first, with what the 24 bytes are and whether the waiting-request case shares its cause; if not, that case returns as a brief and is not built here; after the fix both pass 20 of 20 with no check weakened. docs/status.md lists the gap against JS-088 until it merges. No separate task until the cause is shown to differ.
